# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest published release of European Law Lookup and for the current `main` branch. Older releases may not receive separate fixes; users should update to the latest release when a security fix is published.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Security contact: the repository maintainer, [@GammaFunds](https://github.com/GammaFunds), via the private reporting channel below.

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's security advisory reporting for this repository:

https://github.com/GammaFunds/European-Law-Lookup/security/advisories/new

Do not include vulnerability details, proof-of-concept code, credentials, personal data, or other sensitive information in a public GitHub issue.

If private vulnerability reporting is not available to you, open a public issue containing only a request for a private reporting channel. Do not describe the vulnerability itself in that issue.

Please include, when possible:

- the affected version or commit;
- a clear description of the vulnerability and its impact;
- reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept;
- any known mitigations or workarounds.

## Response and Disclosure

The maintainer aims to acknowledge a vulnerability report within 7 days and provide an initial assessment within 14 days.

Please allow time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure. The project aims for coordinated disclosure after a fix is available, with a target of resolving or otherwise coordinating disclosure within 90 days of the initial report. The timeline may be adjusted when additional time is required to protect users, coordinate with upstream projects, or address active exploitation.

Security advisories and release notes may be used to communicate confirmed vulnerabilities and available fixes.
